examples.ar: أَمَلُنَا فِي اللهِ كَبِيرٌ فِي تَخَطِّي هَذِهِ العَقَبَاتِ.
examples.en: Our hope in God is great in overcoming these obstacles.

examples.ar: يَحْمِلُ الشَّبَابُ أَمَلَ الأُمَّةِ وَمُسْتَقْبَلَهَا.
examples.en: The youth carry the hope and the future of the nation.

examples.ar: وَالأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلأَنَامِ.
examples.en: And the earth He has laid out for the creatures.

examples.ar: تَدُورُ الأَرْضُ حَوْلَ الشَّمْسِ دَوْرَةً كَامِلَةً كُلَّ عَامٍ.
examples.en: The earth revolves around the sun once every year.

examples.ar: الأَخُ الصَّالِحُ سَنَدٌ لِأَخِيهِ فِي المُلِمَّاتِ.
examples.en: A righteous brother is a support for his brother in calamities.

examples.ar: إِنَّمَا المُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ.
examples.en: The believers are but brothers.

examples.ar: يَنْصَحُ الأَبُ أَبْنَاءَهُ بِحِكْمَةٍ وَعَطْفٍ.
examples.en: The father advises his children with wisdom and kindness.

examples.ar: وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا.
examples.en: And show kindness to parents.

examples.ar: الأُمُّ مَدْرَسَةٌ إِذَا أَعْدَدْتَهَا أَعْدَدْتَ شَعْبًا طَيِّبَ الأَعْرَاقِ.
examples.en: The mother is a school; if you prepare her, you prepare a nation of noble descent.

examples.ar: وَحَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا.
examples.en: And his mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship.

examples.ar: تَرَكَ المُعَلِّمُ أَثَرًا طَيِّبًا فِي نُفُوسِ تَلَامِيذِهِ.
examples.en: The teacher left a good impact in the souls of his pupils.

examples.ar: تِلْكَ آثَارُنَا تَدُلُّ عَلَيْنَا.
examples.en: These are our ruins; they indicate who we were.

examples.ar: الأَدَبُ يَرْفَعُ شَأْنَ صَاحِبِهِ وَلَوْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا.
examples.en: Good manners elevate the status of their owner even if he is poor.

examples.ar: يَدْرُسُ الطُّلَّابُ الأَدَبَ العَرَبِيَّ الكِلَاسِيكِيَّ.
examples.en: The students study classical Arabic literature.

examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَنْ تُؤَدُّوا الْأَمَانَاتِ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا.
examples.en: Indeed, God commands you to render trusts to their owners.

examples.ar: الأَمَانَةُ صِفَةٌ أَسَاسِيَّةٌ لِتَحْقِيقِ الثِّقَةِ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ.
examples.en: Trustworthiness is an essential trait for building confidence among people.

examples.ar: يَبْعَثُ الإِيمَانُ الطُّمَأْنِينَةَ وَالسَّكِينَةَ فِي القُلُوبِ.
examples.en: Faith sends tranquility and peace into hearts.

examples.ar: الإِيمَانُ مَا وَقَرَ فِي القَلْبِ وَصَدَّقَهُ العَمَلُ.
examples.en: Faith is what is established in the heart and verified by deeds.

examples.ar: هَلْ جَزَاءُ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَّا الْإِحْسَانُ.
examples.en: Is the reward for goodness anything but goodness?

examples.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ نُعَامِلَ النَّاسَ بِإِحْسَانٍ وَلُطْفٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
examples.en: We must treat people with excellence and kindness every day.
